panels.title: Masked log lines (24h)
panels.description: Lines that had a full phone number or a key, masked before Loki kept them: the code that logged them must change.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_phone_total[24h]) and loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_phone_total offset 24h) or vector(0)) + (sum(loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_phone_total unless loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_phone_total offset 24h) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_secret_total[24h]) and loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_secret_total offset 24h) or vector(0)) + (sum(loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_secret_total unless loki_process_custom_log_lines_with_secret_total offset 24h) or vector(0))

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: What fires now, since when. Silences: Alertmanager (127.0.0.1:9093).

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, service) (ALERTS_FOR_STATE) * 1000 and on (alertname, severity, service) max by (alertname, severity, service) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing"})

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Each service UP (green) or DOWN (red) over the time range.
